Method of Attack: Malicious JavaScript scripts embedded in EXIF data of a favicon image to steal submitted credit card information
Injection of remote favicon image containing malicious skimmer scripts
Scripts send stolen credit card data back to attacker-controlled server
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious scripts hidden in EXIF data of favicon image loaded on checkout pages
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious JavaScript scripts embedded in EXIF data of favicon image
Remote favicon image containing skimmer scripts
Credit card data exfiltration to attacker-controlled server
